analysis.summary: A tenant eviction dispute arising in Mumbai involving the rights and obligations of a landlord and tenant. The matter likely concerns grounds for eviction, tenancy termination, and applicable rent control legislation in Maharashtra. The dispute may involve issues of possession, arrears of rent, or unauthorized occupation.

issues.issue: Grounds for eviction of tenant and validity of eviction notice
Termination of tenancy and requirement of notice
Tenant's right to protection against arbitrary eviction under rent control legislation
Recovery of possession and arrears of rent
issues.governing_law: Code of Civil Procedure 1908, Order 20 Rule 12

multi_match.query: Maharashtra Rent Control Act eviction notice quit

match.text: Transfer of Property Act Section 106 notice to quit

match.headline: Bombay High Court eviction landlord tenant

plan.esql: FROM legal-judgments | WHERE (text LIKE "*eviction*" OR text LIKE "*tenant*" OR text LIKE "*Maharashtra Rent Control*") AND (text LIKE "*Mumbai*" OR text LIKE "*Bombay*") | KEEP title, headline, catchwords, text | LIMIT 10
plan.search_rationale: The query targets key legal terms — eviction, tenant, landlord, Maharashtra Rent Control Act, and Mumbai/Bombay — across title, headline, catchwords, and full text fields to surface the most relevant prior judgments from Bombay High Court and subordinate courts dealing with tenant eviction disputes under Maharashtra rent control and property transfer law.
